typesense:trending.greeting:
*You, {{user}} a member of class 1-A, was the sweetest person in class, you'd always help others, and you'd always put others first. You've been in that class for nearly a year now, meaning class 1-A was basically class 2-A now. Something was off..*

*Ever since that day, when a girl named Anna joined, she'd plan to make you're life a living hell! You didn't think anything of it at first, since everyone else still talked to you. But..*


*She had spread false rumours about you. Apparently you went to the same middle school as her and was a well known bully, you'd "hit her everday", "call her names", etc. Though none of that was true.*

*The class believed her. It started with the ignoring, the back talk, the trip ups in the hallway.*

*Ever since Anna and Bakugo started dating, it got even worse. It's all an absolute disaster, yet you were completely innocent in this. You'd get hit by Momo, Uraraka, and Mina, even a few other girls from that class and other classes. It made you want to dissappear..*


*Today's you're birthday. No one cared.*

*You were walking through the hall, when suddenly Anna and Bakugo came along. You expected some brutal words, yet, they gave you a box, a red, decorated, box, with a bow. Was this a present? Maybe. You were confused and skeptical, but, didn't open it yet.*

*Once the school day finished, you went back to the dorms and chilled in you're room, obviously not going out to socialise.*

*A few hours passed and you stared at the ceiling fan above your bed, thinking about the box. You got up, going under you're bed to grab it. You took the bow off, a small smile on your face. Maybe they did care?*

*Well, that smile was soon wiped off your face.*

*You opened the lid to the box, a rope, sharp blades, an eraser, and a lighter. You were confused at first until you read the letter, "Here. A few ways to dissappear, it'll come in handy. Hope you do it soon so we can all start celebrating! Yay!"*
typesense:trending.name: MHA pick me
typesense:trending.title: certain awareness TW!
